title: Huge Amazon Prime Big Deals Sports Tech Tracker!
content:
Amazon’s running its Prime Big Deal Days today and tomorrow (6th and 7th), which includes a decent chunk of sports tech deals – including on some newly released products (like the Apple Watch Ultra 4, Pixel Watch 5, GoPro Mission 1 Pro, and more!).

Here’s the Top 5 items that DC Rainmaker readers bought on Day 1 (and all are still available):

1) Wahoo Fitness KICKR CORE 2 with Zwift Cog V2: This is probably one of the strongest deals, at just $399, including the new Zwift Cog V2 & new Zwift Clicks. Plus, of course, the newish KICKR CORE 2 trainer. There’s also the mechanical 12-spd cassette version too for the same price.

2) Apple AirPods Pro 3 (with optical HR for workouts): Down to just $179, these are both my wife’s and my go-to headphones for virtually everything. Travel, editing, work, workouts, etc…

3) DJI NEO Self-Following Drone: At merely $139USD, this is a steal for one of the best and most indestructible options on the market. Both my kids and I have tried to kill it. No luck. Hundreds of crashes later during all sorts of running, cycling, etc… and it’s still perfectly fine.

4) Anker 25,000mAh Laptop/etc High Speed Power Bank: No surprise, at ~30%, this is a great unit that has become the mainstay of both daily usage (working from a cafe table without a power outlet), to travel usage, to backcountry hikes and long gravel rides. Love it.

5) Garmin Fenix 8 for $731: Again, zero surprise here. Especially with Garmin announcing that almost every Fenix 9 feature is soon coming to the Fenix 8 series, this is a very strong deal.

To take advantage of Amazon Prime Deals, you simply need to be an Amazon Prime member. The good news is that you can sign-up for the free trial and cancel later if you don’t find value in it. Just hit up this giant banner below to do so:

I’ve organized all the best sports technology Amazon Prime Deals (and a few others I’ve found) below in the tables by category. I’ll be updating them throughout the next two days. Keep in mind that not all deals last (in fact, most don’t). So, if you see something that’s hot, I’d strongly suggest buy now (and return later if need be).

With that, onto the deals! And thanks for supporting the site via the links below. As an Amazon Associate, I earn from qualifying purchases. Enjoy!

Watches & Wearables:

This covers anything you can wear that’s watch-like or activity band-like, including sensors.  Generally speaking, you’ll mostly find deals here that are on things I’ve written about in the past.  So you won’t find a deal on some random non-sports tech watch here, or on socks. Unless the socks have some crazy sensor or something in them.
